# DuplicateArrayKeys

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `DuplicateArrayKeysInspection`

In an array literal a repeated string key silently overwrites the earlier
entry. Either the earlier entry is dead (different value) or the whole entry
is a redundant copy (same value).

## Example

```php{4,6,8,10,11,13}
<?php
$settings = [
    7 => 'a',
    '7' => 'a',
    'retries' => 3,
    "retries" => 3,
    'hosts' => ['db1'],
    'hosts' => ['db1'],
    'timeout' => 10,
    'timeout' => 20,
    'timeout' => 10,
    'label' => $prefix . 'x',
    'label' => $prefix.'x',
    "slot-$n" => 1,
    "slot-$n" => 1,
    'mode' => 'fast',
    'nested' => ['mode' => 'slow'],
];
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Same key and value already present; remove this entry.</li>
<li>line 6: Same key and value already present; remove this entry.</li>
<li>line 8: Key already used earlier; the earlier entry is overwritten.</li>
<li>line 10: Key already used earlier; the earlier entry is overwritten.</li>
<li>line 11: Key already used earlier; the earlier entry is overwritten.</li>
<li>line 13: Same key and value already present; remove this entry.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DuplicateArrayKeys": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DuplicateArrayKeys

/**
 * @noinspection DuplicateArrayKeysInspection
 */
```
